fact: The INE's Estatísticas do Comércio Externo - Ano 2024 (published April 2025) states its base data come from the Direção Geral das Alfândegas (DGA) as electronic files resulting from the use of customs administrative acts (Sidónia ++), extracted monthly, so customs trade statistics have two editions (2024, and the 2025 annual summary).
title: Estatísticas do Comércio Externo - Ano 2024
